title: Noise-regularized training of quantum circuit Born machines under a finite shot budget
abstract: arXiv:2611.06630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum circuit Born machines (QCBMs) can learn distributions that are hard to sample from classically, but their value depends on generalizing from finite training data. Here, we study how hardware noise affects this generalization. We show that, for any noise process, the generalization gap of a QCBM trained with the maximum mean discrepancy is bounded by the complexity of the distributions the noisy model can reach. Scrambled local Pauli noise contracts this complexity but biases the model towards the uniform distribution, so residual noise acts as a regularizer whose optimal strength can be intermediate. We propose GENIE, a framework that realizes a chosen noise level with capped error mitigation and selects it during training from held-out data within a fixed execution budget, with provably bounded regret. translated_title: 有限测量预算下量子电路玻恩机器的噪声正则化训练
translated_abstract: 量子电路玻恩机器能够学习经典计算机难以采样的分布，但其价值取决于能否从有限的训练数据中进行泛化。本文研究了硬件噪声如何影响这种泛化能力。我们证明，对于任何噪声过程，使用最大均值差异训练的QCBM的泛化差距受该噪声模型所能达到的分布复杂度限制。扰动的局域泡利噪声会收缩这种复杂度，但会使模型偏向均匀分布，因此残余噪声起到正则化的作用，其最优强度可以是中等水平。我们提出了GENIE框架，该框架通过有上限的误差缓解实现所选定的噪声水平，并在固定的执行预算内于训练过程中从留出数据中选择噪声水平，且具有可证明的有界遗憾。在合成数据和人口普查数据的模拟中，GENIE的表现始终接近四种噪声控制策略中的最优者，而任何固定的噪声选择都可能是次优的。
tldr: 该论文证明硬件噪声可作为量子电路玻恩机器的正则化手段以提升泛化能力，并提出GENIE框架在有限测量预算内自动选择最优噪声水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that hardware noise acts as a regularizer for quantum circuit Born machines to improve generalization, and proposes the GENIE framework to automatically select the optimal noise level within a finite shot budget.
